sentences.text: Germanosaurus is classified as a reptile.
It belongs to the family Nothosauridae.
The type species G. latissimus was originally named as a species of Nothosaurus.
Rieppel (1997) considered the species G. latissimus to be a nomen dubium.
Germanosaurus lived in what is now Upper Silesia, Poland.
The fossils date to about 247 million years ago during the early Anisian stage of the early Middle Triassic.
